question: Who among the following won the ICC U19 Women's T20 World Cup 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India won the ICC U19 Women's T20 World Cup 2023, marking a historic achievement.
 
• The tournament was held in South Africa, and the final match took place on 29 January 2023.
 
• India defeated England by 7 wickets in the final to clinch the title.
 
• This victory is significant as it showcases the growing talent and potential of women's cricket in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ICC U19 Women's T20 World Cup**

 
 
• The ICC U19 Women's T20 World Cup is an international cricket tournament organized by the International Cricket Council (ICC) for national teams with players under the age of 19.
 
• It is the inaugural edition of the ICC U19 Women's T20 World Cup, aimed at providing young women cricketers with a platform to showcase their talent on a global stage.
 
• The tournament format includes a round-robin stage followed by knockout rounds, including semi-finals and the final.
 
• Participating teams from various cricketing nations compete in this tournament, promoting the development of women's cricket worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Women's Cricket in India**
 
 
• Women's cricket in India has seen significant growth over the past few years, with increased participation and performance on the international stage.
 
• The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has been instrumental in promoting women's cricket through domestic tournaments like the Women's T20 Challenge.
 
• Indian women's cricket team has achieved notable success, including reaching the finals of the ICC Women's T20 World Cup and ICC Women's Cricket World Cup.
 
• The victory in the ICC U19 Women's T20 World Cup 2023 is expected to further inspire young girls to take up the sport and pursue a career in cricket.
 
 
 
• **International Cricket Council (ICC)**
 
 
• The ICC is the global governing body for cricket, responsible for the organization and governance of major international cricket tournaments.
 
• Founded in 1909, the ICC's headquarters are located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
 
• The ICC organizes events like the ICC Cricket World Cup, ICC T20 World Cup, ICC Champions Trophy, and ICC U19 Cricket World Cup.
 
• The ICC's mission is to promote and develop the game of cricket worldwide, ensuring fair play and integrity in the sport.
